title: Artifacts by Databox
claim: Product Hunt: Artifacts by Databox — Ask your AI Analyst and get back a ready-to-share report
why_good: Turns a question into a ready-to-share analytics report — real pain for ops/marketing teams drowning in dashboards.
value: Databox already sells analytics; this is a feature/upsell within an established BI company, not a founder opening.
risk: Backed by Databox and squarely in crowded BI (Tableau, Metabase, every AI-BI startup); not a green field.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Artifacts by Databox —— 问你的 AI 分析师,拿回可直接分享的报告。
zh.why_good: 把一个问题变成可直接分享的分析报告——对淹没在仪表盘里的运营/营销团队是真实痛点。
zh.value: Databox 已在卖分析;这是一家成熟 BI 公司里的功能/加售,不是创始人的口子。
zh.risk: 背靠 Databox,且正处拥挤的 BI(Tableau、Metabase、各家 AI-BI);不是蓝海。
